name: Edythe Harrison
summary: Edythe Colton Harrison (September 17, 1934 – September 1, 2026) was an American politician who served as a member of the Virginia House of Delegates from 1980 to 1983. She lost renomination to Tom Moss in 1982 after the state's House district maps were redrawn. In 1984, she ran for United States Senate, losing to the Republican incumbent, John Warner.
